title: March of the Machine: The Aftermath: card flavor text
storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath

entities.name: Ikoria
entities.description: A plane whose wrecked cities had to be cleared of monsters after the invasion.

entities.name: Orazca
entities.description: A city where survivors cleared rubble using former war mounts.

entities.name: New Capenna
entities.description: A plane whose angels turned on their former captors, the demons, and where Ob Nixilis was stranded.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: The invaders, defeated but whose invasion rippled through the Blind Eternities.

entities.name: Blind Eternities
entities.description: The space between planes, rippled by the repercussions of the invasion.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: A planeswalker who broke inside when a relic shattered and who insists Zendikar is her home.

entities.name: Nissa
entities.description: A planeswalker who tapped Zhalfir's leylines and dealt with an unfamiliar creature as she would any threat.

entities.name: Zhalfir
entities.description: A plane Nissa discovered to be not a piece of Dominaria but a plane all its own.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: A plane Zhalfir was once thought to be part of.

entities.name: The Endsaga
entities.description: An in-world text quoted on the theme that new stories begin when old ones end.

entities.name: Danitha
entities.description: Raised to lead House Capashen, she mourned that the opportunity came so soon.

entities.name: House Capashen
entities.description: A house Danitha prepared her whole life to lead.

entities.name: Jirina
entities.description: A general who says strength lies in people, not walls.

entities.name: Narset
entities.description: A character whose unique insight was called a gift, then a threat.

entities.name: Ob Nixilis
entities.description: Stranded on New Capenna without a spark, facing five families out for blood.

entities.name: Pia Nalaar
entities.description: A renegade turned revolutionary turned rebuilder.

entities.name: Samut
entities.description: A vizier who urges Djeru to keep up with the work.

entities.name: Djeru
entities.description: Addressed by Samut.

entities.name: Tyvar
entities.description: A warrior who declares that today they become gods again.

entities.name: Drannith
entities.description: A city reduced to a playground for Ikoria's monsters.

entities.name: Orn
entities.description: A place that, like Drannith, was reduced to a playground for monsters.

entities.name: Reckoner
entities.description: Violent fighters who, as the flavor text says, die as Reckoners.

entities.name: Lorehold
entities.description: A college whose specialty is reconstructing the past.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: A Phyrexian leader in New Phyrexia whom boastful survivors claim to have beaten up.

entities.name: Huatli
entities.description: Built a device Saheeli would have been proud of.

entities.name: Saheeli
entities.description: An artificer whose work Huatli's device echoes.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: Nahiri's home plane.

entities.name: Nashi
entities.description: A character linked to the continuing story circle.

events.summary: Ikoria's wrecked cities must be cleared of monsters before rebuilding.
events.quote: It was a time for rebuilding, but first Ikoria's wrecked cities had to be cleared of monsters.

events.summary: Survivors use former war mounts to clear rubble in Orazca.
events.quote: Survivors put the strength of former war mounts to good use clearing the rubble of Orazca.

events.summary: With the ancient enemy vanquished, the angels of New Capenna turn on their former captors, demons.
events.quote: With their ancient enemy vanquished, the angels of New Capenna turned their eyes to their former captors: demons.

events.summary: Phyrexia is defeated, but the invasion's repercussions ripple through the Blind Eternities.
events.quote: Phyrexia was defeated, but the repercussions of the invasion rippled through the Blind Eternities.

events.summary: A relic shatters and something in Nahiri breaks as well.
events.quote: The relic shattered, and something in Nahiri broke as well.

events.summary: Nissa taps Zhalfir's leylines and finds a plane all its own.
events.quote: When Nissa tapped into Zhalfir's leylines, she was shocked to feel not a piece of Dominaria, but a plane all its own.

events.summary: Danitha takes up leadership of House Capashen sooner than she hoped.
events.quote: Danitha had spent her whole life preparing to lead House Capashen, but she mourned that the opportunity had come so soon.

events.summary: Ob Nixilis is stranded on New Capenna without a spark, facing the five families.
events.quote: Stranded on New Capenna without a spark, he faced five families out for blood.

events.summary: Drannith is reduced to a playground for Ikoria's monsters, as Orn was.
events.quote: Like Orn before it, Drannith was reduced to a playground for Ikoria's monsters.

events.summary: Nissa deals with an unfamiliar creature as she would any threat.
events.quote: The creature was unlike any Nissa had seen, but she dealt with it as she would any threat.

events.summary: Survivors boast that they charged into New Phyrexia and beat up Elesh Norn.
events.quote: To hear them tell it, they charged bare-handed into New Phyrexia and beat up Elesh Norn all by themselves.

events.summary: Huatli builds a device Saheeli would have been proud of.
events.quote: Worlds apart, Huatli built a device Saheeli would have been proud of.

relations.note: Danitha prepared to lead the house
relations.quote: Danitha had spent her whole life preparing to lead House Capashen
